title: DWUG: A large Resource of Diachronic Word Usage Graphs in Four Languages

selection.evidence: Source of 5 of the 8 public gold sets in arena-lsc's dev pool (DWUG EN/DE/SV, and the same pipeline for ES/IT); read to know how that gold was made before scoring systems against it.

cost.compute_notes: arXiv v3 PDF pp. 1-9 read (procedure, clustering, resource, disagreement analysis); appendices skimmed. Zenodo DWUG EN/DE/SV v3.0.0 (+ES 4.0.2, IT) downloaded, converted to SemEval-2027 Task 3 format and scored with that task's official scorer.

triggers: word usage graph correlation clustering 2.5 shift

claims.statement: Senses are not annotated directly: annotators judge usage pairs on the DURel 1-4 relatedness scale over several adaptive sampling rounds (~50% of pairs double-annotated); edge weights are shifted by -2.5 and the graph is clustered by correlation clustering (minimise positive weight across + |negative weight| within clusters) approximated by simulated annealing; clusters are read as senses.
claims.scope: EN/DE/SV usage-usage graphs, 100 usages per period per word (fewer if rare); LA uses usage-sense graphs.

our_assessment.why: Well documented and the data match the description (cluster -1 marks usages left out: 272 EN, 251 DE, 905 SV of the v3.0.0 usages). For anyone using DWUG as SENSE gold: the senses are clusters of a sparse, noisy proximity graph (alpha .53-.61), not dictionary senses, so a model that reproduces the WUG pipeline on its own similarities gets a structural advantage (cf. periti2024 NAACL c3), and DWUG k is not comparable to dictionary sense counts.

claims.statement: Swedish data (Kubhist newspapers, 1790-1830 vs 1895-1903) contains frequent OCR errors and has a markedly higher share of 'cannot decide' (0) judgments than EN/DE.

our_assessment.why: Consistent with the converted SV set: 905 of 8,750 usages carry cluster -1 (10.3%, vs 3% EN). Relevant beyond DWUG: SemEval-2027 Task 3 SV dev usages from 1880-1915 show the same OCR noise.

checked.how: sh .claude/memory/maria/arena-lsc/tooling/fetch_public.sh; python .../tooling/convert_public.py dwug <x/dwug_xx> <gold/dwug_xx> --code XX; python .../tooling/harness.py controls --gold <gold/dwug_xx>
checked.result: gold-as-prediction scores 1.0 under the SemEval-2027 Task 3 scorer; EN 46 words / 8,835 usages, DE 50 / 8,874, SV 44 / 7,845 after dropping cluster -1
